address: 12 rue de la Mer, Plouider, 29260, France
bio: This extension of the gourmet flagship, La Butte, sports a modern layout with an open kitchen and a bakery-cum-shop. Chef Nicolas Conraux specialises in wholesome traditional fare deeply entrenched in the Finistère region. The set menu is both well-curated and well-priced and those with a sweet tooth will be bowled over by the eat-as-much-as-you-like dessert buffet....
